title: verify.rs HlcNotMonotonic error message says '<=' but check is strict '<'
description: core/group_log/verify.rs: HlcNotMonotonic format string says 'entry timestamp {entry} <= parent timestamp {parent}' but the actual check fires when parent >= entry (i.e., entry is not strictly greater). Message should say 'entry timestamp is not strictly greater than parent timestamp' to match the semantics.
